items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I went on the road with Woody, no not with Woody Herman, with Buddy Morrow’s band in 1959, ‘60, for $150 a week

ctx.x: What was a club date paying in the early ‘60s?

Well I think — I went on the road, let me see I went on the road with Woody, no not with Woody Herman, with Buddy Morrow’s band in 1959, ‘60, for $150 a week, and saved almost all of it, came back with more money than I had ever had in my life. Then I went © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -7-

to New York, I think I was making $150 a week in 1961. I mean whatever that came to a night, it was six nights. And I was paying rent and my apartment was $150 a month, I had six rooms, five rooms on Riverside Drive for $150 a month, and I could have kept it. I could have kept it and today it would be $600. But I gave it up, and left New York in 1963. I had been drinking too much. You know I was a kid and I just wasn’t in shape for that kind of thing. And I was messing around and drinking and so I left, unhappy,…
